subject: Invoice #HB-1193 — unexpected usage snapshot and request for correlation
messages:
From: Priyanka Shah <pri@hyperbyte.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Hyperbyte Billing <billing@hyperbyte.com>
Date: Thu, 21 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: High invoice this month — can you help correlate usage?

Hi Jordan,

We just received invoice HB-1193 and the total is ~3.4x higher than our usual monthly run-rate. Our finance team flagged a large token volume attributed to our ingestion pipeline (session tagging). We don't have an internal change that would explain this spike.

Can you:
- Confirm which endpoints/models generated the majority of the tokens?
- Provide per-route/day token counts (May 17-21) and any sampling logs you have?
- Advise if there were rolling reprocesses or backfills on Redwood's side that could cause retroactive counts.

We'd like to avoid putting payment on hold but need evidence before we can clear the bill. Attaching our internal billing export (small stub).

Thanks — Priyanka
Priyanka Shah
Head of Payments, Hyperbyte Inc.
pri@hyperbyte.com

Attachment: hyperbyte_billing_export_may21.csv (referenced)
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Priyanka Shah <pri@hyperbyte.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 21 May 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: High invoice this month — can you help correlate usage?

Hi Priyanka — thanks for flagging this and sorry for the surprise.

Quick note on next steps from our side:
- I've pulled a preliminary usage snapshot and asked our metering team to produce per-route token counts for May 17–21.
- Looping in Karthik (metering lead) and Marissa (billing ops) to triage logs and evidence. Ben — FYI in case we need provisional credit approval.

We expect to send a short evidence pack (per-route CSV + sampling logs) within 24 hours. If the spike is due to a backfill or reprocess initiated by Hyperbyte, please call that out; otherwise we'll look for anomalies on our pipeline (duplicate replay, orphaned sessions, or a change in tokenization).

Jordan
Jordan Blake
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0162
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>

Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 22 May 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: High invoice this month — can you help correlate usage? (preliminary findings)

Hi Priyanka / Jordan,

Thanks for the patience — I dug into the metering traces and attached the evidence bundle. High-level summary first:

Summary of findings (preliminary):
- Primary contributor: a burst of ~1.1M tokens on 2026-05-18 attributed to your ingest route /v1/streaming/ingest.
- Tokenization change? No — we see the same tokenizer version across the window.
- Likely cause: a backfill replay from Hyperbyte's staging cluster. The replay shows many near-duplicate request-ids and identical payloads between 2026-05-17 22:00 UTC and 2026-05-18 03:00 UTC.
- Our sampling logs include original_request_id and an md5(payload) column for quick dedupe; see sampling_logs_may21.csv.

What we attached:
- usage_snapshot_may21.json — per-route/per-model token counts for May 17–21 (CSV-style JSON).
- sampling_logs_may21.csv — sampled request_ids with md5(payload), timestamps, and inferred duplicate flag.
- redwood_evidence_readme.txt — short notes on how to interpret the files and our dedup method.

Recommended next steps:
1) If Hyperbyte confirms an intentional replay/backfill, we can offer a one-time pro-rated credit for duplicated tokens (policy: credits for client-initiated replays when evidence provided). Please confirm who on your side ran the replay (name, CI job id).
2) If you did not run a replay, we'll continue digging on the ingress layer and storage fan-out for accidental replays and provide a follow-up report by EOD Monday.
3) As an interim measure we can propose a provisional credit of 45% on the duplicated portion while we finish the root-cause (Ben and finance tagged).

Priyanka — could you please:
- Check with engineering for any CI/CD job ids or reprocess windows around May 17–18.
- Share any internal replay job ids or a pointer to your S3/queue reprocessor logs (if available).

Ben — I included a short note below for provisional credit approval flow.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Billing Operations Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

Attachment: usage_snapshot_may21.json, sampling_logs_may21.csv, redwood_evidence_readme.txt
